question: How soon after sign-off must the scheme for offsetting opposite grid mismatches be running, and for which grid area must it at least be used?
reply: {"gold_answers": "yes", "gold_reason": "Article 22(5) of Regulation 2017/2195 requires TSOs to implement and operate the European imbalance netting platform one year after approval of the implementation framework, using it at least for the Continental Europe synchronous area. This matches the reference answer.", "other_articles": [], "ambiguity": "minor", "ambiguity_reason": "The paraphrase ('scheme for offsetting opposite grid mismatches', 'sign-off') is vague but points to the imbalance netting platform and its approval. Article 146 of the system operation guideline covers imbalance netting but sets no such deadline.", "suggested_fix": ""}

verdict.gold_reason: Article 22(5) of Regulation 2017/2195 requires TSOs to implement and operate the European imbalance netting platform one year after approval of the implementation framework, using it at least for the Continental Europe synchronous area. This matches the reference answer.
verdict.ambiguity_reason: The paraphrase ('scheme for offsetting opposite grid mismatches', 'sign-off') is vague but points to the imbalance netting platform and its approval. Article 146 of the system operation guideline covers imbalance netting but sets no such deadline.
